reviewed-guitar-positions.json contains 16 selected entries copied from
lib/guitar.json at the revision above, wrapped with source and review identifiers.
The original position fields are preserved. No upstream test code is included.
Source positionIndex is zero-based within key/suffix positions.

The selection covers open shapes, movable shapes, partial/full and double barres,
multiple fingers at the same fret, and barres across unplayed strings.
It is intentionally not an endorsement of every entry in the upstream database.
The tests independently reconstruct absolute pitches from string tuning, frets
and baseFret, then compare the retained MIDI values. Finger assignments are
acceptable alternatives, not a requirement to choose a single optimal answer.

Conventions:
- arrays run low E to high E;
- fret -1 means the string is not played, fret 0 stays open;
- positive frets are diagram-relative: actual = fret + baseFret - 1;
- finger 0 on a negative fret is normalized to null in our API;
- upstream capo describes a barre-style diagram, not an external capo shift.

The duplicate-candidate assertion is independently written. The general idea
also appears in Conchordance's InstrumentTest.testAlternateFingerings:
https://github.com/ConchordanceProject/Conchordance/blob/master/src/test/java/com/conchordance/fretted/InstrumentTest.java
